name: drupal/surface
description: A runtime definition layer between Form API and storage: groups of refinable core data definitions that drive generated forms, validation, and machine-readable contracts.

suggest.drupal/address: Enables the surface_examples_address submodule, which describes the address field type's instance settings as a surface.
suggest.drupal/tool: Opens the Tool API door: one tool per operation, a read tool and a narrowing tool beside it, for agents, MCP, ECA and Drush.
